q: 我在商店里面，你快进___吧。
zh: 我在商店里面，你快进来吧。
py: wǒ zài shāng diàn lǐ miàn nǐ kuài jìn lái ba
en: I'm inside the shop, come in quickly.
why: The speaker is already inside, so the movement ends where the speaker is: 进来. 进去 would fit only if the speaker stood outside the shop.

q: 我在楼上等你，你怎么还不上___？
zh: 我在楼上等你，你怎么还不上来？
py: wǒ zài lóu shàng děng nǐ nǐ zěn me hái bù shàng lái
en: I'm waiting upstairs. Why haven't you come up yet?
why: The speaker is upstairs, so going up means moving toward the speaker: 上来. English 'go up' tempts learners into 上去.

q: 我现在在商场，钱包忘在家里了，得马上回___拿。
zh: 我现在在商场，钱包忘在家里了，得马上回去拿。
py: wǒ xiàn zài zài shāng chǎng qián bāo wàng zài jiā lǐ le děi mǎ shàng huí qù ná
en: I'm at the mall now and I left my wallet at home, so I have to go back for it right away.
why: The speaker is at the mall and home is somewhere else, so going back moves away from the speaker: 回去. 回来 would mean heading to where the speaker is.

q: 我在场外看球，球员们都跑进___了。
zh: 我在场外看球，球员们都跑进去了。
py: wǒ zài chǎng wài kàn qiú qiú yuán men dōu pǎo jìn qù le
en: I'm watching from outside the pitch, and the players have all run in.
why: The speaker stands outside, so running into the pitch moves away from the speaker: 进去. 进来 needs the speaker to be inside.

q: 小李不在这儿，他刚才出___买东西了。
zh: 小李不在这儿，他刚才出去买东西了。
py: xiǎo lǐ bù zài zhè r tā gāng cái chū qù mǎi dōng xī le
en: Xiao Li isn't here. He just went out to buy something.
why: He is not where the speaker is and the movement leads away from here: 出去. 出来 would mean coming out toward the speaker.

q: 售货员站在柜台里面说：“您过___看看这双鞋吧。”
zh: 售货员站在柜台里面说：“您过来看看这双鞋吧。”
py: shòu huò yuán zhàn zài guì tái lǐ miàn shuō ：“ nín guò lái kàn kàn zhè shuāng xié ba ”
en: The salesperson, standing behind the counter, says: "Come over and have a look at these shoes."
why: The salesperson is the speaker and wants the customer to cross the space toward her: 过来. 过去 would send the customer away from her.

q: 我已经在健身房里了，你拿着会员卡，直接走进___就行。
zh: 我已经在健身房里了，你拿着会员卡，直接走进来就行。
py: wǒ yǐ jīng zài jiàn shēn fáng lǐ le nǐ ná zhe huì yuán kǎ zhí jiē zǒu jìn lái jiù xíng
en: I'm already inside the gym. Just take your membership card and walk straight in.
why: The speaker is inside the gym, so the listener walks toward the speaker: 走进来. The tempting 去 matches English 'go in', but it ignores where the speaker is.

q: 请大家站___，我们拍一张照片。
zh: 请大家站起来，我们拍一张照片。
py: qǐng dà jiā zhàn qǐ lái wǒ men pāi yī zhāng zhào piān
en: Everyone, please stand up, so we can take a photo.
why: Standing up from a seat is 站起来: 起 only pairs with 来 and means rising with no destination. 站上来 would mean stepping up onto something.

q: 小王累了，在球场边的椅子上坐___休息。
zh: 小王累了，在球场边的椅子上坐下来休息。
py: xiǎo wáng lèi le zài qiú chǎng biān de yǐ zi shàng zuò xià lái xiū xī
en: Xiao Wang was tired and sat down on a chair beside the pitch to rest.
why: Sitting down is 坐下来: the body settles downward. 坐起来 means to sit up from lying, which does not fit resting on a chair.

q: 比赛一开始，观众们都站___大声喊加油。
zh: 比赛一开始，观众们都站起来大声喊加油。
py: bǐ sài yī kāi shǐ guān zhòng men dōu zhàn qǐ lái dà shēng hǎn jiā yóu
en: As soon as the match began, the spectators all stood up and shouted "Go!"
why: Rising from a seat is 站起来. 站下来 would mean coming to a halt, and 上去 and 出去 need a place they move to.

q: 钱包掉到地上了，他弯腰把它捡___。
zh: 钱包掉到地上了，他弯腰把它捡起来。
py: qián bāo diào dào dì shàng le tā wān yāo bǎ tā jiǎn qǐ lái
en: His wallet fell on the floor, and he bent down and picked it up.
why: Lifting something off the ground is 捡起来. 起 gives the upward movement, and the others (进去, 出来, 回去) need a container or a destination.

q: 看见好朋友在马路对面，小王高兴地跑___和他打招呼。
zh: 看见好朋友在马路对面，小王高兴地跑过去和他打招呼。
py: kàn jiàn hǎo péng yǒu zài mǎ lù duì miàn xiǎo wáng gāo xìng dì pǎo guò qù hé tā dǎ zhāo hū
en: Seeing his good friend across the road, Xiao Wang happily ran over to say hello.
why: Crossing the street away from the narrator is 跑过去. 上去 and 下来 are about height, and 回去 means returning where he came from.

q: 比赛结束后，球迷们都从看台上走___，慢慢往外走。
zh: 比赛结束后，球迷们都从看台上走下来，慢慢往外走。
py: bǐ sài jié shù hòu qiú mí men dōu cóng kàn tái shàng zǒu xià lái màn màn wǎng wài zǒu
en: After the match, the fans all came down from the stands and slowly headed out.
why: Leaving a raised stand is a downward movement, 走下来. 走上去 goes up, 走起来 would be starting to walk, 走进去 goes inside.

q: 妈妈买完菜，已经回___去了。
zh: 妈妈买完菜，已经回家去了。
py: mā mā mǎi wán cài yǐ jīng huí jiā qù le
en: Mum finished buying vegetables and has already gone home.
why: The place 家 must come between 回 and 去. Nothing may follow 去 except 了, and 来, 里, 到 do not fit before 去.

q: 小李跑进___来，大声说今天打折。
zh: 小李跑进商店来，大声说今天打折。
py: xiǎo lǐ pǎo jìn shāng diàn lái dà shēng shuō jīn tiān dǎ zhé
en: Xiao Li ran into the shop and announced loudly that there was a discount today.
why: The place word goes between 进 and 来: 跑进商店来. Putting 来 or 去 in this slot would double up the direction word.

q: 买完运动鞋，我们就一起走上___去了。
zh: 买完运动鞋，我们就一起走上三楼去了。
py: mǎi wán yùn dòng xié wǒ men jiù yì qǐ zǒu shàng sān lóu qù le
en: After buying the sports shoes we walked up to the third floor together.
why: The destination 三楼 sits between 上 and 去: 走上三楼去了. A bare 来 or 去 in the blank would leave no place, and 在 is not a direction word.

q: 你什么时候回___来看这场比赛？
zh: 你什么时候回上海来看这场比赛？
py: nǐ shén me shí hòu huí shàng hǎi lái kàn zhè chǎng bǐ sài
en: When are you coming back to Shanghai to see this match?
why: A place follows the direction word and precedes 来: 回上海来. The sentence already ends the phrase with 来, so another 来 or 去 cannot fill the slot.

q: 比赛一结束，球迷们都跑进___去，围住了自己最喜欢的球员。
zh: 比赛一结束，球迷们都跑进球场去，围住了自己最喜欢的球员。
py: bǐ sài yī jié shù qiú mí men dōu pǎo jìn qiú chǎng qù wéi zhù le zì jǐ zuì xǐ huān de qiú yuán
en: As soon as the match ended, the fans all ran onto the pitch and surrounded their favourite player.
why: The place 球场 goes between 进 and 去. 到球场 would add a second direction word, and a bare 来 or 去 leaves out the place.

q: 我们在门口付了钱，然后一起走进___去看比赛。
zh: 我们在门口付了钱，然后一起走进体育馆去看比赛。
py: wǒ men zài mén kǒu fù le qián rán hòu yì qǐ zǒu jìn tǐ yù guǎn qù kàn bǐ sài
en: We paid at the entrance and then walked into the stadium together to watch the match.
why: The place 体育馆 belongs between 进 and 去: 走进体育馆去. 走进去体育馆 puts the place after 去, which is never allowed.

q: 小王从包里拿出一张银行卡___，付了钱。
zh: 小王从包里拿出一张银行卡来，付了钱。
py: xiǎo wáng cóng bāo lǐ ná chū yī zhāng yín háng kǎ lái fù le qián
en: Xiao Wang took a bank card out of his bag and paid.
why: A thing taken out of a container comes toward the person with it: 拿出一张银行卡来. 去 would send it away, and 起 or 上 mean other things.

q: 朋友从国外给我带___了一双运动鞋。
zh: 朋友从国外给我带来了一双运动鞋。
py: péng yǒu cóng guó wài gěi wǒ dài lái le yī shuāng yùn dòng xié
en: A friend brought me a pair of sports shoes from abroad.
why: The shoes arrive to me, so the direction word is 来: 带来了. 带去 would mean taking something away from the speaker.

q: 老板想了半天，终于从抽屉里拿___一张发票来。
zh: 老板想了半天，终于从抽屉里拿出一张发票来。
py: lǎo bǎn xiǎng le bàn tiān zhōng yú cóng chōu ti lǐ ná chū yī zhāng fā piào lái
en: After thinking for a long time, the boss finally took a receipt out of the drawer.
why: Something coming out of a drawer is 拿出...来. 进 goes in, and 上 and 下 describe height, so only 出 fits 从抽屉里.

q: 请___这些苹果拿进去。
zh: 请把这些苹果拿进去。
py: qǐng bǎ zhè xiē píng guǒ ná jìn qù
en: Please take these apples inside.
why: The specific apples are moved, so 把 puts them before 拿进去. 被 would make them the doer, and 对 and 让 do not form this pattern.

q: 售货员没___新衣服拿出来给我看。
zh: 售货员没把新衣服拿出来给我看。
py: shòu huò yuán méi bǎ xīn yī fú ná chū lái gěi wǒ kàn
en: The shop assistant didn't take the new clothes out to show me.
why: The thing being moved needs 把, with 没 placed before it: 没把...拿出来. 被 and 对 give a different meaning, and 给 cannot introduce the moved object.

q: 这些钱你先___它存进银行去吧。
zh: 这些钱你先把它存进银行去吧。
py: zhè xiē qián nǐ xiān bǎ tā cún jìn yín háng qù ba
en: Put this money into the bank first.
why: 把 + object + verb + direction + place + 去 moves the money. The object 它 has to precede the verb, so 被, 对 and 向 are not possible here.

q: 我帮你把行李拿上___去。
zh: 我帮你把行李拿上楼去。
py: wǒ bāng nǐ bǎ xíng li ná shàng lóu qù
en: I'll help you carry the luggage upstairs.
why: Inside a 把 sentence the place word still goes between the direction word and 去: 拿上楼去. 拿上去楼 breaks the place rule.

q: 你应该___这双旧球鞋拿回商店去换。
zh: 你应该把这双旧球鞋拿回商店去换。
py: nǐ yīng gāi bǎ zhè shuāng jiù qiú xié ná huí shāng diàn qù huàn
en: You should take these old sports shoes back to the shop and exchange them.
why: The modal 应该 sits before 把, and the pair of shoes is moved: 把...拿回商店去. The other options cannot take the object before 拿回.

q: 比赛一开始，大家都喊___了。
zh: 比赛一开始，大家都喊起来了。
py: bǐ sài yī kāi shǐ dà jiā dōu hǎn qǐ lái le
en: As soon as the match began, everybody started shouting.
why: The action starts and builds up, which is 起来. 下去 would be continuing a shout already underway, and 下来 means settling down.

q: 这双运动鞋看___很贵，其实很便宜。
zh: 这双运动鞋看起来很贵，其实很便宜。
py: zhè shuāng yùn dòng xié kàn qǐ lái hěn guì qí shí hěn pián yi
en: These sports shoes look expensive, but they are actually cheap.
why: An impression from looking is 看起来 + comment. 看出来 means working something out, and it cannot take a comment like 很贵 directly.

q: 外面突然下___大雨来，比赛只好停了。
zh: 外面突然下起大雨来，比赛只好停了。
py: wài miàn tū rán xià qǐ dà yǔ lái bǐ sài zhǐ hǎo tíng le
en: It suddenly started pouring outside, so the match had to stop.
why: The object 大雨 goes inside 起来: 下起大雨来 for something starting. 下出 and 下上 are not forms, and 下下 does not combine with 来.

q: 这双球鞋穿___很舒服，我想再买一双。
zh: 这双球鞋穿起来很舒服，我想再买一双。
py: zhè shuāng qiú xié chuān qǐ lái hěn shū fú wǒ xiǎng zài mǎi yī shuāng
en: These shoes are comfortable to wear, so I want to buy another pair.
why: 穿起来 + comment gives your experience of wearing something. 穿上去 is not a form, and 穿下来 or 穿出来 do not mean 'comfortable to wear'.

q: 天气一暖和，公园里打球的人就多___了。
zh: 天气一暖和，公园里打球的人就多起来了。
py: tiān qì yī nuǎn huo gōng yuán lǐ dǎ qiú de rén jiù duō qǐ lái le
en: As soon as the weather warmed up, more and more people started playing ball in the park.
why: A number that grows takes 起来: 多起来了. 下来 is for things that settle, quiet or slow, which is the opposite direction.

q: 他们几个一见面就聊___篮球来，常常聊到商店关门。
zh: 他们几个一见面就聊起篮球来，常常聊到商店关门。
py: tā men jǐ gè yī jiàn miàn jiù liáo qǐ lán qiú lái cháng cháng liáo dào shāng diàn guān mén
en: As soon as they meet, the few of them start talking basketball and often chat until the shop closes.
why: Starting a topic with an object puts the object inside: 聊起篮球来. 聊出篮球 and 聊下篮球 would give a different meaning or none.

q: 这家店的价格听___不错，我们进去看看吧。
zh: 这家店的价格听起来不错，我们进去看看吧。
py: zhè jiā diàn de jià gé tīng qǐ lái bù cuò wǒ men jìn qù kàn kàn ba
en: The prices at this shop sound good, so let's go in and take a look.
why: 听起来 + comment is the impression from what you hear. 听出来 would claim you worked something out, and 下去 and 上去 do not fit.

q: 别停，你继续跑___，还有两圈。
zh: 别停，你继续跑下去，还有两圈。
py: bié tíng nǐ jì xù pǎo xià qù hái yǒu liǎng quān
en: Don't stop, keep running. There are two laps left.
why: The runner carries on from now on, which is 下去. 下来 would mean having come to rest, and 起来 would be starting to run.

q: 球赛太精彩了，他们一边喝水一边看___。
zh: 球赛太精彩了，他们一边喝水一边看下去。
py: qiú sài tài jīng cǎi le tā men yī biān hē shuǐ yī biān kàn xià qù
en: The match was so thrilling that they drank water while they kept on watching.
why: Carrying on with a match that is under way is 看下去. 看下来 would be having sat through it, and 看起来 means 'looks'.

q: 教练说：“请大家停___，休息五分钟。”
zh: 教练说：“请大家停下来，休息五分钟。”
py: jiào liàn shuō ：“ qǐng dà jiā tíng xià lái xiū xī wǔ fēn zhōng ”
en: The coach said, "Everyone, please stop and rest for five minutes."
why: Coming to a stop is 停下来. 停下去 is not used, and 停起来 would be starting to stop.

q: 听到哨声，吵闹的球场慢慢安静___了。
zh: 听到哨声，吵闹的球场慢慢安静下来了。
py: tīng dào shào shēng chǎo nào de qiú chǎng màn màn ān jìng xià lái le
en: At the sound of the whistle, the noisy pitch slowly quietened down.
why: Getting quieter settles downward: 安静下来. 安静起来 would be becoming livelier, and 安静下去 would mean staying quiet from now on.

q: 你每个月都买这么多东西，再这样买___，钱很快就会花完。
zh: 你每个月都买这么多东西，再这样买下去，钱很快就会花完。
py: nǐ měi gè yuè dōu mǎi zhè me duō dōng xī zài zhè yàng mǎi xià qù qián hěn kuài jiù huì huā wán
en: You buy so much every month. If you keep buying like this, the money will soon run out.
why: 再这样 + verb + 下去 means keep doing it from now on. 起来 would be starting to buy, and 下来 means something has already been settled.

q: 东西太多了，我怕忘了，先把价钱记___吧。
zh: 东西太多了，我怕忘了，先把价钱记下来吧。
py: dōng xī tài duō le wǒ pà wàng le xiān bǎ jià qián jì xià lái ba
en: There are so many things that I'm afraid I'll forget. Let me note the prices down first.
why: Fixing something so it is not lost is 记下来. 记下去 would be going on remembering, and 记出来 or 记过来 are not 'write down'.

q: 他在网球场练了三年，虽然很辛苦，但是终于坚持___了。
zh: 他在网球场练了三年，虽然很辛苦，但是终于坚持下来了。
py: tā zài wǎng qiú chǎng liàn le sān nián suī rán hěn xīn kǔ dàn shì zhōng yú jiān chí xià lái le
en: He trained at the tennis court for three years. It was hard, but he finally stuck it out.
why: The three years are over and the persistence is complete, so 坚持下来了. 坚持起来 would be starting to persist, and 过来 or 出来 do not mean having stuck it out.

q: 这家运动用品店的老板想让我留___工作，可是我已经买好回国的票了。
zh: 这家运动用品店的老板想让我留下来工作，可是我已经买好回国的票了。
py: zhè jiā yùn dòng yòng pǐn diàn de lǎo bǎn xiǎng ràng wǒ liú xià lái gōng zuò kě shì wǒ yǐ jīng mǎi hǎo huí guó de piào le
en: The owner of this sports shop wanted me to stay on and work, but I had already bought my ticket home.
why: Staying in a place is 留下来. 留下去 and 留起来 do not express staying, and 留出来 means setting something aside.

q: 我一看就看___这件衣服是假的。
zh: 我一看就看出来这件衣服是假的。
py: wǒ yī kàn jiù kàn chū lái zhè jiàn yī fú shì jiǎ de
en: I could tell at a glance that this piece of clothing is a fake.
why: Working out something hidden by looking is 看出来. 看起来 only gives an impression and could not be followed by a verdict like 是假的 in this way.

q: 电话里的声音很小，可是我一听就听___是教练。
zh: 电话里的声音很小，可是我一听就听出来是教练。
py: diàn huà lǐ de shēng yīn hěn xiǎo kě shì wǒ yī tīng jiù tīng chū lái shì jiào liàn
en: The voice on the phone was very faint, but I recognised it as the coach the moment I heard it.
why: Recognising by sound is 听出来. 听起来 would be 'sounds like', and it cannot repeat the verb after 一听就.

q: 以前没有人想过，是他第一个想___了这个省钱的办法。
zh: 以前没有人想过，是他第一个想出了这个省钱的办法。
py: yǐ qián méi yǒu rén xiǎng guò shì tā dì yí gè xiǎng chū le zhè ge shěng qián de bàn fǎ
en: Nobody had thought of it before. He was the first to come up with this way of saving money.
why: Inventing something new is 想出. 想起 is only for recalling something you already knew, which does not fit a brand-new idea.

q: 我终于想___他的名字了，他叫小李！
zh: 我终于想起他的名字了，他叫小李！
py: wǒ zhōng yú xiǎng qǐ tā de míng zì le tā jiào xiǎo lǐ
en: I finally remembered his name, he is called Xiao Li!
why: A name you already knew is recalled: 想起. 想出 is for creating something new, such as an idea or a plan.

q: 你说___你想要什么颜色，我们才能帮你选。
zh: 你说出来你想要什么颜色，我们才能帮你选。
py: nǐ shuō chū lái nǐ xiǎng yào shén me yán sè wǒ men cái néng bāng nǐ xuǎn
en: Tell us which colour you want, and then we can help you choose.
why: Putting a hidden wish into words is 说出来. 说起来 means 'speaking of', and 说下来 or 说上去 are not forms that fit.

q: 她换了发型，变化很大，我差一点没认___，以为是别人。
zh: 她换了发型，变化很大，我差一点没认出来，以为是别人。
py: tā huàn le fà xíng biàn huà hěn dà wǒ chà yì diǎn méi rèn chū lái yǐ wéi shì bié rén
en: She changed her hairstyle and looks so different that I almost didn't recognise her and thought it was someone else.
why: Telling who someone is by looking is 认出来. 认起来 and 认下去 are not words, and 认上去 does not exist either.

q: 这台游戏机是他自己做___的，比商店里卖的还好。
zh: 这台游戏机是他自己做出来的，比商店里卖的还好。
py: zhè tái yóu xì jī shì tā zì jǐ zuò chū lái de bǐ shāng diàn lǐ mài de hái hǎo
en: He made this game console himself, and it is even better than the ones sold in shops.
why: Making something that did not exist is 做出来. 做起来 would be 'when it comes to doing it', and 做下来 means finishing a long stretch.

q: 天太冷了，你把外套穿___吧。
zh: 天太冷了，你把外套穿上吧。
py: tiān tài lěng le nǐ bǎ wài tào chuān shàng ba
en: It's too cold, put your coat on.
why: Putting on clothes is 穿上: the item attaches to the body. 穿下 means taking off (it is not used alone), and 穿出来 or 穿起来 do not mean put on.

q: 出门的时候，请把门关___。
zh: 出门的时候，请把门关上。
py: chū mén de shí hòu qǐng bǎ mén guān shàng
en: When you go out, please close the door.
why: Shutting is 关上: the door joins the frame. The others are directional movements and give no closing sense.

q: 我弟弟今年终于考___了他最想去的体育大学。
zh: 我弟弟今年终于考上了他最想去的体育大学。
py: wǒ dì di jīn nián zhōng yú kǎo shàng le tā zuì xiǎng qù de tǐ yù dà xué
en: My younger brother finally got into the sports university he most wanted to attend this year.
why: Reaching a goal like entering a school is 考上. 考下 and 考起 are not used here, and 考回 would mean taking an exam back.

q: 他在商店里看到一个很可爱的小熊，一下子就爱___了它。
zh: 他在商店里看到一个很可爱的小熊，一下子就爱上了它。
py: tā zài shāng diàn lǐ kàn dào yí gè hěn kě ài de xiǎo xióng yī xià zi jiù ài shàng le tā
en: He saw a very cute little bear in the shop and fell in love with it at once.
why: Falling for something is 爱上: a new state begins. 爱出 and 爱起 are not words, and 爱过 would mean having loved it before.

q: 他踢球时撞到头晕倒了，过了一分钟才醒___。
zh: 他踢球时撞到头晕倒了，过了一分钟才醒过来。
py: tā tī qiú shí zhuàng dào tóu yūn dǎo le guò le yì fēn zhōng cái xǐng guò lái
en: He hit his head while playing football and passed out, and only came round after a minute.
why: Coming back to consciousness is 醒过来. 醒过去 reverses it, 醒起来 is not used, and 醒出来 does not exist.

q: 我站在球场这边，看见对面的三个孩子正朝我走___。
zh: 我站在球场这边，看见对面的三个孩子正朝我走过来。
py: wǒ zhàn zài qiú chǎng zhè biān kàn jiàn duì miàn de sān gè hái zi zhèng cháo wǒ zǒu guò lái
en: I'm standing on this side of the pitch and see three children on the far side walking toward me.
why: They cross toward the speaker, so 走过来. 走过去 is away from me, and 走起来 or 走下来 do not describe crossing.

zh: 她买完东西就回家去了。
py: tā mǎi wán dōng xī jiù huí jiā qù le
en: After she finished shopping, she went home.
why: The place 回家 comes before 去, and 去 closes the phrase. 回去家 is impossible because a place cannot follow 去.

zh: 孩子们都跑进商店来了。
py: hái zi men dōu pǎo jìn shāng diàn lái le
en: The children all ran into the shop.
why: The place 商店 splits 跑进 and 来: 跑进商店来. Putting 商店 after 来 would break the place rule.

zh: 比赛结束后球迷们都走出体育馆去了。
py: bǐ sài jié shù hòu qiú mí men dōu zǒu chū tǐ yù guǎn qù le
en: After the match, the fans all walked out of the stadium.
why: 走出体育馆去 puts the place between 出 and 去. The time phrase may sit before or after the subject, but 体育馆 must stay before 去.

zh: 她从包里拿出一张优惠券来。
py: tā cóng bāo lǐ ná chū yī zhāng yōu huì quàn lái
en: She took a coupon out of her bag.
why: A thing object can go before 来 (拿出一张优惠券来) or after it (拿出来一张优惠券). The direction word 出 stays right after 拿.

zh: 请你带一个球来。
py: qǐng nǐ dài yí gè qiú lái
en: Please bring a ball.
why: A thing object may stand before or after 来. The verb 带 comes first, with 来 either before or after the object.

zh: 我把新球拍带回家去了。
py: wǒ bǎ xīn qiú pāi dài huí jiā qù le
en: I took the new racket home.
why: 把 puts the new racket before the verb. The place 回家 stays before 去, and 了 goes last.

zh: 请你把这些衣服搬进来。
py: qǐng nǐ bǎ zhè xiē yī fú bān jìn lái
en: Please carry these clothes in.
why: 把 and its object come before the verb, and the whole 搬进来 stays together at the end. 搬进来把这些衣服 is wrong.

zh: 老板没把那箱运动饮料从仓库里搬出来。
py: lǎo bǎn méi bǎ nà xiāng yùn dòng yǐn liào cóng cāng kù lǐ bān chū lái
en: The boss didn't carry that case of sports drinks out of the warehouse.
why: 没 goes before 把, never after it. 从仓库里 comes between the object and the verb, and 搬出来 stays together.

zh: 我帮你把这箱水果搬上楼去。
py: wǒ bāng nǐ bǎ zhè xiāng shuǐ guǒ bān shàng lóu qù
en: I'll help you carry this box of fruit upstairs.
why: 把 + object + verb + direction + place + 去. The place 楼 must come before 去, so 搬上去楼 is wrong.

zh: 这双球鞋看起来很新。
py: zhè shuāng qiú xié kàn qǐ lái hěn xīn
en: These sports shoes look new.
why: 看起来 + comment gives an impression. The comment 很新 comes after 起来, and 看出来很新 would mean something else.

zh: 外面突然下起雨来了。
py: wài miàn tū rán xià qǐ yǔ lái le
en: It suddenly started to rain outside.
why: The object 雨 goes inside 起来: 下起雨来. 下雨起来 is wrong. 外面 and 突然 may swap places, but 起 and 来 stay split around 雨.

zh: 请你把这个价格写下来。
py: qǐng nǐ bǎ zhè ge jià gé xiě xià lái
en: Please write this price down.
why: Fixing something on paper is 写下来, and the object goes after 把. 写下去 would mean keep writing, and 写下来把这个价格 breaks the 把 order.

zh: 比赛开始前球场慢慢安静下来了。
py: bǐ sài kāi shǐ qián qiú chǎng màn màn ān jìng xià lái le
en: Before the match began, the pitch slowly went quiet.
why: Quieting is 安静下来: 下来 attaches directly to the adjective. The time phrase may stand before or after 球场, but 慢慢 stays before 安静.

zh: 他一听就听出来是教练的声音。
py: tā yī tīng jiù tīng chū lái shì jiào liàn de shēng yīn
en: He could tell it was the coach's voice the moment he heard it.
why: 一听就听出来 means he recognised the voice. 听出来 is followed by the clause 是教练的声音, so the complement stays attached to 听.

zh: 老板把店门关上了。
py: lǎo bǎn bǎ diàn mén guān shàng le
en: The boss closed the shop door.
why: 把 + object + 关上 + 了: 上 means closing, and 了 goes at the end. 关上了店门把 and 把关上店门 are wrong.

src: 那件外套，妈妈拿回来了。
src_py: nà jiàn wài tào mā mā ná huí lái le
zh: 妈妈把那件外套拿回来了。
py: mā mā bǎ nà jiàn wài tào ná huí lái le
en: Mum brought that coat back.
why: 把 moves the topic-fronted object 那件外套 in front of the verb, and the complement 拿回来 and 了 stay together at the end.

src: 那双球鞋，售货员拿出来给我看了。
src_py: nà shuāng qiú xié shòu huò yuán ná chū lái gěi wǒ kàn le
zh: 售货员把那双球鞋拿出来给我看了。
py: shòu huò yuán bǎ nà shuāng qiú xié ná chū lái gěi wǒ kàn le
en: The shop assistant took out those shoes and showed them to me.
why: 把 brings the object 那双球鞋 before the verb. 拿出来 stays together, and 给我看了 follows as the second action.

src_py: wǒ bǎ qián bāo dài huí lái le
zh: 我没把钱包带回来。
py: wǒ méi bǎ qián bāo dài huí lái
en: I didn't bring my wallet back.
why: The negative 没 goes before 把, and the 了 of the positive sentence disappears: 我没把钱包带回来.

src: 她把新球拍拿上楼去了。
src_py: tā bǎ xīn qiú pāi ná shàng lóu qù le
zh: 她没把新球拍拿上楼去。
py: tā méi bǎ xīn qiú pāi ná shàng lóu qù
en: She didn't take the new racket upstairs.
why: 没 stands before 把 and 了 is dropped. The place 楼 still sits between 上 and 去: 拿上楼去.

zh: 外面下起雨来了。
py: wài miàn xià qǐ yǔ lái le
en: It started raining outside.
why: Starting uses 起来 with the object inside it: 下起雨来了. 下雨起来 breaks the rule.

src: 我觉得那家店的东西很贵。
src_py: wǒ jué de nà jiā diàn de dōng xī hěn guì
zh: 那家店的东西看起来很贵。
py: nà jiā diàn de dōng xī kàn qǐ lái hěn guì
en: The things in that shop look expensive.
why: 看起来 + comment expresses an impression. The thing being judged becomes the subject, and the comment 很贵 follows.

src_py: qǐng nǐ xiě zhè ge hào mǎ
task: Say "write it down" with 下来.
zh: 请你把这个号码写下来。
py: qǐng nǐ bǎ zhè ge hào mǎ xiě xià lái
en: Please write this number down.
why: Making a note so it is not lost uses 写下来 with 把 and the object before the verb. 写下去 would mean continuing to write.

src_py: zhè yàng mǎi dōng xī qián huì bù gòu
task: Say "if you keep on like this" with 下去.
zh: 再这样买下去钱会不够。
py: zài zhè yàng mǎi xià qù qián huì bù gòu
en: If we keep on buying like this, the money won't be enough.
why: 再这样买下去 means continuing a habit from now on. 下去 ends the first clause and takes no object, so the result 钱会不够 follows.

src_py: wǒ zhī dào zhè ge bāo shì jiǎ de
task: Say you could tell by looking, with 看出来.
zh: 我看出来这个包是假的。
py: wǒ kàn chū lái zhè ge bāo shì jiǎ de
en: I can tell this bag is a fake.
why: Working something out by looking is 看出来, followed by the clause 这个包是假的. 看起来 would only report an impression.

src_py: tā chuān shàng le wài tào
zh: 他把外套穿上了。
py: tā bǎ wài tào chuān shàng le
en: He put his coat on.
why: 把 puts the coat before the verb; 穿上 keeps its 上 and 了 follows at the end.

s: 我在楼下等你，你快下去吧。
s_py: wǒ zài lóu xià děng nǐ nǐ kuài xià qù ba
zh: 我在楼下等你，你快下来吧。
py: wǒ zài lóu xià děng nǐ nǐ kuài xià lái ba
en: I'm waiting downstairs, come down quickly.
why: The speaker is downstairs, so the listener moves toward the speaker: 下来. 下去 would be used if the speaker were upstairs.

s: 我在商店外面等，朋友们都进去看球鞋了。
s_py: wǒ zài shāng diàn wài miàn děng péng yǒu men dōu jìn qù kàn qiú xié le
zh: 我在商店外面等，朋友们都进去看球鞋了。
py: wǒ zài shāng diàn wài miàn děng péng yǒu men dōu jìn qù kàn qiú xié le
en: I'm waiting outside the shop, and my friends have all gone in to look at sports shoes.
why: The speaker is outside, so going in is away from the speaker: 进去. It looks like it needs 来 because of English 'come in', but the speaker's place decides it.

s: 他跑进去商店买了一瓶水。
s_py: tā pǎo jìn qù shāng diàn mǎi le yī píng shuǐ
zh: 他跑进商店去买了一瓶水。
py: tā pǎo jìn shāng diàn qù mǎi le yī píng shuǐ
en: He ran into the shop and bought a bottle of water.
why: The place 商店 cannot follow 进去. It goes between 进 and 去: 跑进商店去. Both 进 and 去 are fine; the order is what is wrong.

s: 你什么时候回上海来买新手机？
s_py: nǐ shén me shí hòu huí shàng hǎi lái mǎi xīn shǒu jī
zh: 你什么时候回上海来买新手机？
py: nǐ shén me shí hòu huí shàng hǎi lái mǎi xīn shǒu jī
en: When are you coming back to Shanghai to buy a new phone?
why: The place 上海 sits between 回 and 来, which is the correct order. The sentence looks odd because the verb 买 follows 来, but 来 is closing the direction phrase.

s: 他从包里拿来出一张卡。
s_py: tā cóng bāo lǐ ná lái chū yī zhāng kǎ
zh: 他从包里拿出一张卡来。
py: tā cóng bāo lǐ ná chū yī zhāng kǎ lái
en: He took a card out of his bag.
why: The direction word comes right after the verb (拿出) and 来 follows it. 拿来出 swaps the two parts.

s: 她从钱包里拿出来一百块钱。
s_py: tā cóng qián bāo lǐ ná chū lái yì bǎi kuài qián
zh: 她从钱包里拿出来一百块钱。
py: tā cóng qián bāo lǐ ná chū lái yì bǎi kuài qián
en: She took one hundred yuan out of her wallet.
why: A thing object can come after 来: 拿出来一百块钱 is just as correct as 拿出一百块钱来. It looks wrong only if you think 来 must be last.

s: 他把新球拍带回去学校了。
s_py: tā bǎ xīn qiú pāi dài huí qù xué xiào le
zh: 他把新球拍带回学校去了。
py: tā bǎ xīn qiú pāi dài huí xué xiào qù le
en: He took his new racket back to school.
why: The place 学校 must come between 回 and 去. 带回去学校 puts the place after 去, which is not allowed even inside a 把 sentence.

s: 我没把那双球鞋带回来。
s_py: wǒ méi bǎ nà shuāng qiú xié dài huí lái
zh: 我没把那双球鞋带回来。
py: wǒ méi bǎ nà shuāng qiú xié dài huí lái
en: I didn't bring those shoes back.
why: The negative 没 goes before 把, and the complement 带回来 stays with the verb. A learner may want 了, but 没 already rules it out.

s: 我把钱包没带出来。
s_py: wǒ bǎ qián bāo méi dài chū lái
zh: 我没把钱包带出来。
py: wǒ méi bǎ qián bāo dài chū lái
en: I didn't bring my wallet out.
why: 没 must stand before 把, not between 把 + object and the verb. 把钱包没带出来 is not a Chinese sentence.

s: 老板想把那些旧运动鞋都搬出去卖掉。
s_py: lǎo bǎn xiǎng bǎ nà xiē jiù yùn dòng xié dōu bān chū qù mài diào
zh: 老板想把那些旧运动鞋都搬出去卖掉。
py: lǎo bǎn xiǎng bǎ nà xiē jiù yùn dòng xié dōu bān chū qù mài diào
en: The boss wants to carry all those old sports shoes out and sell them.
why: 想 goes before 把, and 都 sits with the object. The movement ends away from where the boss stands: 搬出去, with 卖掉 as the next step.

s: 球场上突然下雨起来了。
s_py: qiú chǎng shàng tū rán xià yǔ qǐ lái le
zh: 球场上突然下起雨来了。
py: qiú chǎng shàng tū rán xià qǐ yǔ lái le
en: It suddenly started to rain on the pitch.
why: With 起来 meaning start, the object 雨 goes between 起 and 来: 下起雨来. 下雨起来 puts it before 起来.

s: 这双鞋穿起来很舒服，价格也不贵。
s_py: zhè shuāng xié chuān qǐ lái hěn shū fú jià gé yě bù guì
zh: 这双鞋穿起来很舒服，价格也不贵。
py: zhè shuāng xié chuān qǐ lái hěn shū fú jià gé yě bù guì
en: These shoes are comfortable to wear, and the price isn't high either.
why: 穿起来 + comment is a correct impression pattern. It looks wrong if you expect 起来 to mean standing up, but here it simply gives how it feels.

s: 你看出来很高兴。
s_py: nǐ kàn chū lái hěn gāo xìng
zh: 你看起来很高兴。
py: nǐ kàn qǐ lái hěn gāo xìng
en: You look happy.
why: An impression of how someone looks is 看起来 + comment. 看出来 means to work something out, and it cannot be followed by a bare comment like 很高兴.

s: 这个游戏说起来简单，做起来却不容易。
s_py: zhè ge yóu xì shuō qǐ lái jiǎn dān zuò qǐ lái què bù róng yì
zh: 这个游戏说起来简单，做起来却不容易。
py: zhè ge yóu xì shuō qǐ lái jiǎn dān zuò qǐ lái què bù róng yì
en: This game is easy to explain but not easy to do.
why: 说起来 and 做起来 are standard 'when it comes to' contrasts, and 起来 is not about starting. A learner may wonder if 起 should split off, but here it should not.

s: 老板说价格会变，你最好把它写下去。
s_py: lǎo bǎn shuō jià gé huì biàn nǐ zuì hǎo bǎ tā xiě xià qù
zh: 老板说价格会变，你最好把它写下来。
py: lǎo bǎn shuō jià gé huì biàn nǐ zuì hǎo bǎ tā xiě xià lái
en: The boss said the price will change, so you'd better write it down.
why: Recording something so it is not lost is 写下来. 写下去 means to carry on writing, which does not fit a note of the price.

s: 这样的比赛虽然很累，但是我想看下去。
s_py: zhè yàng de bǐ sài suī rán hěn lèi dàn shì wǒ xiǎng kàn xià qù
zh: 这样的比赛虽然很累，但是我想看下去。
py: zhè yàng de bǐ sài suī rán hěn lèi dàn shì wǒ xiǎng kàn xià qù
en: Even though a match like this is tiring, I want to keep watching.
why: 看下去 means carry on watching, with no object after 下去. It looks wrong only if you want an object, but the match is already understood.

s: 车在店门口停起来了。
s_py: chē zài diàn mén kǒu tíng qǐ lái le
zh: 车在店门口停下来了。
py: chē zài diàn mén kǒu tíng xià lái le
en: The car came to a stop at the shop entrance.
why: Coming to a stop is 停下来. 停起来 would mean something is starting, which the verb 停 cannot do.

s: 为了省钱，她想出来一个好办法。
s_py: wèi le shěng qián tā xiǎng chū lái yí gè hǎo bàn fǎ
zh: 为了省钱，她想出来一个好办法。
py: wèi le shěng qián tā xiǎng chū lái yí gè hǎo bàn fǎ
en: To save money, she came up with a good idea.
why: Creating a new idea is 想出来. It looks wrong if you confuse it with recalling, but a new method did not exist before, so 出来 is right.

s: 出去的时候请把门关上去。
s_py: chū qù de shí hòu qǐng bǎ mén guān shàng qù
zh: 出去的时候请把门关上。
py: chū qù de shí hòu qǐng bǎ mén guān shàng
en: When you go out, please close the door.
why: 关上 already says the door is shut, so no 来/去 may be added. Adding 去 makes the door move away, which is meaningless.

s: 他踢了一年球，终于考上了体育大学。
s_py: tā tī le yī nián qiú zhōng yú kǎo shàng le tǐ yù dà xué
zh: 他踢了一年球，终于考上了体育大学。
py: tā tī le yī nián qiú zhōng yú kǎo shàng le tǐ yù dà xué
en: He played football for a year and finally got into the sports university.
why: 考上 means reaching a goal, with no 来/去. It may look as if it needs 到 or 进, but 上 is the normal complement for getting into a school.
